items: Leverages Swiss Re's global underwriting platform for Indian commercial risk solutions.
Bajaj Allianz General Insurance partnered with global reinsurer Swiss Re for commercial structured risk coverage.
Focuses on property, casualty, and renewable energy risk underwriting.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
